Scenario 2: Review the Patient Record Continue You have to review Patricia Miller’s morning nursing assessment and identify any missing information, documentation errors, and inconsistencies that need to be addressed. Continue

As you review the patient's record, look beyond what has been documented. Check whether important assessment findings, vital signs, interventions, and patient responses have been recorded. Remember, accurate documentation is essential for safe patient care and effective communication among healthcare professionals. Continue Continue

Congratulations! Exit You've successfully completed the RIVERMERE HEALTH EHR scenarios by demonstrating your ability to select the correct patient, review patient records for accuracy and completeness, identify documentation issues, and choose appropriate next actions while following safe, accurate, and policy-aligned documentation practices. Restart Restart Exit

Ready ? Selecting the Correct Patient 01. Verify two identifiers Confirm the patient's full name and MRN, DOB or another approved identifier. 02. Check for similar records Compare identifiers carefully. Never assume the first search result is correct. 03. Verify the encounter Confirm the encounter type, date, status, clinical unit and whether it matches the task or care activity. 04. Confirm before proceeding Check the patient banner. Stop if any information does not match. Remember A room number or bed location is never an acceptable patient identifier. Ready ?

Got It? EHR Review Record Checklist 01. Patient & Encounter Information Verify patient identifiers, encounter date, unit, and status. Remember A room number or bed location is never an acceptable patient identifier. 02. Allergies & Safety Alerts Review allergies, reactions, and relevant safety alerts. 03. Vital Signs & Assessments Check vital signs, pain assessment, and nursing findings. 04. Medications & Treatments Review medication orders, administration, and treatments. 05. Orders & Investigations Check provider orders, laboratory results, and imaging. 06. Nursing Notes & Documentation Check whether notes are dated, timed, clear, complete, and authenticated. 07. Care Plan & Patient Progress Review goals, interventions, and patient response. 08. Consistency & Completeness Look for missing, conflicting, or inaccurate information. Got It?

Got it ? Choosing the Appropriate Next Action 01. Understand the concern Identify what is missing, inconsistent, or potentially unsafe in the patient's record. 02. Review the available information Check relevant nursing notes, assessments, medication records, provider notes, and orders before deciding what to do. 03. Prioritize patient safety Consider whether the concern requires prompt assessment, intervention, or communication with the appropriate healthcare professional. 04. Follow approved procedures Check the patient banner. Stop if any information does not match. Remember Never delete, alter, or backdate documentation to hide an error. Follow the approved correction or late-entry procedure. 05. Document accurately Record actions taken, relevant communication, the patient's response, and required follow-up according to policy. Got it ?
